_doc: Integration status — what's shipped vs designed vs roadmap. Per docs/A2Z_LIVING_DOCS_PLAN.md Part 3, marked roadmap items are clearly distinguished.

flexcube_12.resilience: retry + circuit breaker + latency telemetry per CBK Operations Resilience Guidelines (2019)

temenos_t24.notes: T24 adapter would follow the same ACL pattern as FLEXCUBE; not yet built. Mark as v9.x candidate.

crb_kenya.notes: Engine designed; production deployment requires CRB API credentials and is bank-specific.

mpesa.notes: M-PESA transaction history feeds the alternative credit scoring engine (utils/alternative_credit_scoring.py); designed but not surfaced in UI.

internal_a2z_blueprint.notes: Local A2Z Blueprint integration uses data/staff_register.xlsx (487 staff, 35 branches) for HRIS-adjacent workflows.

internal_a2z_pipeline.notes: Local pipeline_management.py engine + page 3_pipeline.py provides CRM-adjacent workflows.

honest_scope: Most external system integrations (Salesforce, Workday, SAP, Temenos) are roadmap. v8.x deployments rely on the local A2Z Blueprint conventions.
FLEXCUBE 12 is the only fully-implemented core-banking adapter as of v8.x. Other cores require new ACL implementations following the same pattern.
M-PESA + CRB Kenya integrations are designed at engine level but require API credentials for production deployment; not pre-bundled.
ISO 20022 messaging is roadmap, not shipped.
Real-time payment-network connectivity (RTGS, ACH) is roadmap.
